responsibility: Implements the statement-to-range-operator adapter layer for ranger. It identifies GIMPLE assignments, conditionals, and selected built-in/internal calls that can be modeled by range operators, extracts their relevant operands, supports back-solving operand ranges from an LHS range, and provides specialized handlers for nonstandard tree codes and built-ins such as ctype, bit-counting, strlen, UBSan checks, OpenACC dimension queries, and pass-through intrinsics.
same_name_distinction: Implements the statement-to-range-operator adapter machinery, including operand extraction, supported-statement detection, inverse operand solving, and special handlers for built-ins and nonstandard GIMPLE operations. Unlike gcc/gimple-range-op.h, it provides the handler logic itself rather than just declaring gimple_range_op_handler and helper entry points.
